actions.name: scene.list_entities
actions.description: Return the current live entity paths, names, types, visibility, and parent relationships. With no parent, list the full hierarchy; with a parent path, include that entity and its descendants.

parent.description: Optional exact parent path; null lists root entities.

actions.name: scene.create_primitive
actions.description: Create a Loom unit cube or XZ plane at the local origin or supplied local translation, optionally named, colored, and parented.

name.description: Optional entity name; Loom chooses Cube or Plane when omitted.

parent.description: Exact scene path, or null for root.

actions.name: scene.set_transform
actions.description: Set one or more local transform channels at the current timeline frame.

actions.name: scene.rename
actions.description: Rename one scene entity while Loom keeps sibling names unique.

actions.name: scene.set_visibility
actions.description: Show or hide one scene entity.

actions.name: scene.delete
actions.description: Delete one entity and all of its children. The host must ask for confirmation first.

actions.name: timeline.set_playhead
actions.description: Move Loom's playhead to a frame within the project range.

actions.name: viewport.frame_entity
actions.description: Move the viewport orbit camera to frame an exact scene path or the current selection.

actions.name: procedura.create_recipe
actions.description: Build and evaluate a typed WeaverProcedura graph, then show its generated mesh in the viewport. Supported generators are a triangulated grid surface with optional absolute point heights, and a hallway with rooms on both sides. The graph becomes the current editable Recipe in the Procedura panel; use Save Recipe there to export it.

width.description: Grid width in meters; grid_surface only. Default 8.

depth.description: Grid depth in meters; grid_surface only. Default 8.

cells_x.description: Grid cell count along X, 1–128; grid_surface only. Default 4.

cells_z.description: Grid cell count along Z, 1–128; grid_surface only. Default 4.

point_heights.description: Optional absolute Y heights for zero-based grid points. Coordinates must fit cells_x/cells_z.

rooms_per_side.description: Room bays per side of the central corridor, 1–8; interior_blockout only. Default 2.

room_width.description: Room width in meters; interior_blockout only. Default 4.

room_depth.description: Room depth in meters; interior_blockout only. Default 4.

corridor_width.description: Central corridor width in meters; interior_blockout only. Default 2.

wall_height.description: Wall height in meters; interior_blockout only. Default 3.

wall_thickness.description: Wall thickness in meters; interior_blockout only. Default 0.15.

floor_thickness.description: Floor slab thickness in meters; interior_blockout only. Default 0.12.

door_width.description: Door opening width in meters; interior_blockout only. Default 0.9.
